title: The agony of trying to unsubscribe
speaker: James Veitch

sentences.en: It's funny the things you forget. I went to see my mother the other day, and she told me this story that I'd completely forgotten about how, when we were driving together, she would pull the car over,
sentences.zh: 你忘记的事情很有趣。前几天我去看我妈妈，她给我讲了这个故事，我完全忘记了，当我们一起开车时，她会把车靠边停车，

sentences.en: and by the time she had gotten out of the car, and gone around the car to let me out of the car, I would have already gotten out of the car and pretended to have died.
sentences.zh: 当她下车，绕过车让我下车时，我已经下车装死了。

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) Because that's how you die.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）因为你就是这样死的。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I remember, that was a game I used to play with myself to entertain myself whenever I was bored or frustrated.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我记得，那是我在无聊或沮丧时用来自娱自乐的一个游戏。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Settle down. (Laughter) People say we live in an age of information overload. Right?
sentences.zh: （笑声）安定下来。 （笑声） 人们说我们生活在一个信息超载的时代。正确的？

sentences.en: I don't know about that, but I just know that I get too many marketing emails.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这一点，但我只知道我收到了太多营销电子邮件。

sentences.en: I got a marketing email from a supermarket firm, which will remain nameless for predominantly legal reasons, but which I'm going to call "SafeMart."
sentences.zh: 我收到了一封来自一家超市公司的营销电子邮件，该公司主要出于法律原因将保持匿名，但我将其称为“SafeMart”。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I got an email from them, and it went like this, it said: "Just three weeks until SafeMart at King's Cross opens!!!"
sentences.zh: （笑声）我收到了他们发来的一封电子邮件，内容是这样的，上面写着：“距 King's Cross 的 SafeMart 开业仅剩三周！！！”

sentences.en: And I resented this, because not only do I not remember signing up to that, but I resent the fact that they appear to think that I should be excited about a shop opening.
sentences.zh: 我对此感到不满，因为我不仅不记得签署了该协议，而且我对他们似乎认为我应该对开店感到兴奋这一事实感到不满。

sentences.en: So what I did was I scrolled down to the bottom of the email, and I pressed, "Unsubscribe."
sentences.zh: 所以我所做的就是向下滚动到电子邮件底部，然后按下“取消订阅”。

sentences.en: And I thought that'd be the end of it. But a week later, I got another one that said, "Just two weeks until SafeMart at King's Cross opens!!!"
sentences.zh: 我以为事情就这样结束了。但一周后，我收到另一封邮件，上面写着：“距离 King's Cross 的 SafeMart 开业还有两周！！！”

sentences.en: And I thought, obviously, I haven't clicked hard enough.
sentences.zh: 我想，显然，我点击的力度还不够。

sentences.en: So I tried it again. Right? Lo and behold, a week passes, you guessed it, "Just one week until SafeMart at King's Cross opens!!!"
sentences.zh: 于是我又试了一次。正确的？你瞧，一周过去了，你猜对了，“距离 King's Cross 的 SafeMart 开业还有一周！！！”

sentences.en: And here's the problem: The internet gave us access to everything; but it also gave everything access to us.
sentences.zh: 问题是：互联网让我们可以接触到一切；但它也让我们可以访问一切。

sentences.en: It's hard enough to discriminate between the things that genuinely matter in this world and the minutiae of life, without having emails about supermarket chains and Candy Crush Saga.
sentences.zh: 如果没有关于连锁超市和《糖果粉碎传奇》的电子邮件，就很难区分这个世界上真正重要的事情和生活的细节。

sentences.en: And I was really annoyed with them, and I thought, OK, I was about to write a strongly worded email, which I can do quite well.
sentences.zh: 我真的对他们很恼火，我想，好吧，我正要写一封措辞强硬的电子邮件，我可以做得很好。

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I thought, no -- I'm going to find the game.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我想，不——我要找到这款游戏。

sentences.en: So I replied to it, and I said, "I literally cannot wait!!!!"
sentences.zh: 所以我回复了它，我说：“我真的等不及了！！！”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "What do you need from me?" They got back to me; a guy called Dan said, "Hi James. I've asked a colleague to help me with your query."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“你需要我做什么？”他们回到了我身边；一个叫丹的人说：“嗨，詹姆斯。我已经请一位同事帮助我解决你的问题。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) Like it needs help. And I said, "What's the plan, Dan?
sentences.zh: （笑声）就像它需要帮助一样。我说：“丹，有什么计划吗？

sentences.en: I'm thinking fireworks, bouncy castle ..."
sentences.zh: 我在想烟花、充气城堡……”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "I'm not sure what you mean."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“我不明白你的意思。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "I'm just tremendously excited about the opening!"
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“我对开幕感到非常兴奋！”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "Do you want to book the bouncy castle or shall I?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）“你想预订充气城堡还是我来预订？”

sentences.en: He said, "I think you have misunderstood."
sentences.zh: 他说：“我想你误会了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "A new store is opening, but there is no celebration planned."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“一家新店即将开业，但没有庆祝活动的计划。”

sentences.en: I said, "But what was all the 'Three weeks until,' 'Two weeks until' emails?
sentences.zh: 我说：“但是那些‘三周后’、‘两周前’的电子邮件是什么意思？

sentences.en: I was getting excited." (Laughter) "I'm sorry you're disappointed."
sentences.zh: 我很兴奋。” （笑声）“很抱歉让你失望了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "Not to worry. Let's do something anyway!
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“别担心，我们还是做点什么吧！

sentences.en: Besides, the deposit on the bouncy castle was non-refundable."
sentences.zh: 而且，充气城堡的押金是不予退还的。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) "If we don't use it, we're out a few hundred quid, Dan."
sentences.zh: （笑声）“如果我们不使用它，我们就会损失几百英镑，丹。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) He said, "Mr. Veitch, I'm not responsible for anything you have ordered."
sentences.zh: （笑声） 他说：“维奇先生，我对你订购的任何东西不负有责任。”

sentences.en: I said, "Let's not get into who did what.
sentences.zh: 我说：“我们不要讨论谁做了什么。

sentences.en: Bottom line: you and I are in this together."
sentences.zh: 底线是：你和我在一起。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) "Question: Will you be there to make sure people take their shoes off?"
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）“问题：你会在那里确保人们脱鞋吗？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'll be honest, then my relationship with Dan deteriorated somewhat, because the next email I got was this: "Thanks for your email - your Case Number is ..."
sentences.zh: （笑声）说实话，然后我和 Dan 的关系有所恶化，因为我收到的下一封电子邮件是这样的：“感谢您的电子邮件 - 您的案件编号是……”

sentences.en: (Laughter) That's outrageous. I said, "Dan?"
sentences.zh: （笑声） 这太离谱了。我说：“丹？”

sentences.en: (Laughter) And I got -- and I was just like, this is ... -- and I, I ....
sentences.zh: （笑声）我得到了——我就想，这是……而且我，我……

sentences.en: And I said, "Danny?" And I thought, this is terrible. All I'm doing is collecting case numbers.
sentences.zh: 我说：“丹尼？”我想，这太可怕了。我所做的只是收集案件编号。

sentences.en: I said, "D-Dog?" (Laughter) "The store is now open."
sentences.zh: 我说：“D、狗？” （笑声） “商店已经开门了。”

sentences.en: (Laughter) I said, "But Dan, they must have wondered why there was no bouncy castle."
sentences.zh: （笑声）我说：“但是丹，他们一定想知道为什么没有充气城堡。”

sentences.en: And then we were back to this. And that might have been the end of the story, but I remembered that anything -- everything -- even something as mundane as getting out of a car,
sentences.zh: 然后我们又回到了这个话题。故事可能就这样结束了，但我记得任何事情——所有事情——甚至像下车这样平凡的事情，

sentences.en: can be fun if you find the right game. So, this is what I replied: [Thanks for your email - your Case Number is #0000001.]
sentences.zh: 如果你找到合适的游戏，会很有趣。所以，这就是我的回复：[感谢您的电子邮件 - 您的案件编号是#0000001。]

sentences.en: (Laughter) (Applause) And we just, uh ...
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声）我们只是，呃......

sentences.en: (Laughter) It was like we were dancing. It was just a beautiful relationship.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 就像我们在跳舞一样。这只是一段美好的关系。

sentences.en: We just kept going. It was lovely. But to be honest, guys, it was quite labor-intensive, and I had other stuff to do, believe it or not.
sentences.zh: 我们继续前进。很可爱。但说实话，伙计们，这是相当劳动密集型的，不管你信不信，我还有其他事情要做。

sentences.en: So what I did is I have a little email auto-replier program.
sentences.zh: 所以我所做的是我有一个小的电子邮件自动回复程序。

sentences.en: And I set it up so every time it receives an email from SafeMart, it just pings one back.
sentences.zh: 我将其设置为每次收到来自 SafeMart 的电子邮件时，它都会回复一封。

sentences.en: So I set it up, and it says, "Thanks for your email - your Case Number is ..."
sentences.zh: 所以我设置了它，它说：“感谢您的电子邮件 - 您的案件编号是......”

sentences.en: Then it has a little formula that I wrote to up the case number every time.
sentences.zh: 然后它有一个小公式，我每次都写它来增加案例数。

sentences.en: And I put it on the server and set it running.
sentences.zh: 我把它放在服务器上 并设置它运行。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I'll be honest, guys -- then I forgot about it.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 我会诚实的,伙计们-- 然后我忘了它。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I checked back on it the other day, and it appears there have been a number of emails going back and forth.
sentences.zh: (笑声) 我检查了回来的一天, 和它似乎有 很多电子邮件 来回。

sentences.en: We're on 21,439. (Applause) It gives me an immense sense of satisfaction to know
sentences.zh: 我们在21,439,这让我非常满意

sentences.en: that these computer programs are just going to be pinging one another for eternity.
sentences.zh: 这些电脑程序 将永远地互相勾引

sentences.en: And as legacies go, I don't think that's bad.
sentences.zh: 作为遗产, 我不认为这是坏的。

sentences.en: So guys, just remember: if ever you feel weighed down by the bureaucracy and often mundanity of modern life, don't fight the frustration.
sentences.zh: 所以,伙计们,只要记住: 如果你觉得自己 被官僚主义压垮了 并且常常被现代生活的 繁华所压抑, 不要和沮丧抗争。

sentences.en: Let it be the catalyst for whimsy. (Laughter) Thank you.
sentences.zh: 让它成为发狂的催化剂 谢谢

sentences.en: (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
